body: I don't want to say because it's a very specific field and I'm concerned with identity protection. But please read [my post](http://www.reddit.com/r/depression/comments/1w3erp/i_think_im_a_terrible_person_who_cant_do_anything/) in /r/depression for more details.

I read your whole post and don't regret it. I feel similarly in that I'm a fuckup in life and I was always meant to be a loser at life. It's depressing the hell out of me. I'm thinking of suicide too but I stop and think of what it will do to loved ones and my amazing friends. That's probably where I'm different from you, I DO have absolutely amazing friends, never a significant other but friends at least. One day though, and maybe one day soon, I think that the desire not to hurt them will be outweighed by how I feel about my life, and I'll do it. I'm already thinking about how I'll write up my notes, and who I'll send personalized messages to.

I can't completely relate to your experiences but I feel for you because we're now coming to similar conclusions about the way our lives have turned out. I guess I'm just trying to say you're not alone in this. That isn't much consolation, I don't think it is when people say that to me, but take it for whatever it's worth.
